aboutH2: Red Road Rise: A Home-Style Recovery Residence in Salmon Arm, BC
intro: Red Road Recovery is an addictions treatment centre for substance abuse and concurrent disorders located in Salmon Arm BC. Our rehabilitation program focuses on healing the mind, body and spirit through the bio/pyscho-social model, integrated with traditional indigenous healing practices and recovery through the 12 Steps. We believe everyone is different with their own underlying issues and needs, hence why we believe in building individualized treatment plans structured to address each client specifically. We have three other locations currently: Red Road Recovery in Sorrento, Red Road Ranch in Lumby and Red Road North in Terrace BC.

Red Road Rise opened in late 2024 as the third house in the Red Road Recovery network. It is a 10-bed home on Foothill Road SW with private and shared bedrooms, and it is one of the houses where BC residents can get a publicly funded bed.

pillars.title: A Lived-In Home on Foothill Road
pillars.body: Rise is a two-storey house set back from Foothill Road SW on the southern edge of Salmon Arm, with a lawn, stone-walled garden beds and evergreens around it. The centre describes it as a comfortable, home-like setting, and at 10 beds it is the smallest of the Shuswap houses. Bedrooms are private or shared and bathrooms are shared. A canvas yurt sits in the trees behind the house, and downtown Salmon Arm is a short drive away.

pillars.title: Public and Private Beds Under One Roof
pillars.body: Rise holds both kinds of bed. Publicly funded places come from a CMHA grant that covers 23 beds across the Red Road network, and they cost nothing for BC residents aged 19 and over, with no income check. Private beds are open to people from anywhere and are usually paid by the person, family, a First Nation Band, an employer or insurance. First Nations clients can apply to the First Nations Health Authority for a subsidy, Bands can contract a bed for the year to skip waitlists, and Medicard offers payment plans.

pillars.title: Support That Carries On From Salmon Arm
pillars.body: Red Road's counsellors build a plan for leaving before your stay ends. Aftercare across the network includes virtual one-to-one counselling and support meetings, and the recovery.com profile for Rise adds online follow-up sessions, the option to call a counsellor and alumni reunions.

overview: Rise follows the same CARF-accredited model as every Red Road house. Each resident has a counsellor and a written plan, and the week mixes group and one-on-one sessions with recovery education, life skills and an introduction to the 12 Steps. Cultural programming is offered with local Indigenous partners and can include smudging, medicine wheel teachings, land-based activities and time with Elders. The program is co-ed and for adults 19 and over.

location.intro: Red Road Rise sits on Foothill Road SW at the south end of Salmon Arm, the main town of the Shuswap. Vancouver is about 5 hours away by car through Kamloops, Kamloops itself is about 1 hour 15 minutes west, Vernon is around 45 minutes south and Kelowna roughly 1 hour 30 minutes.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: Does Red Road Rise have publicly funded beds?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre says Rise has both privately and publicly funded beds. The public beds come from a CMHA grant, are free for BC residents aged 19 and over and need no income verification. Call 250-800-3190 to ask about the current wait.

faqs.q: How much does a private bed at Red Road Rise cost?
faqs.a: Red Road does not publish prices and asks people to contact admissions for them. Private beds are usually paid by the client, family, a First Nation Band, an employer or insurance, and FNHA subsidy and Medicard payment plans can help. The total also depends on the length you pick: 30, 45, 60 or 90 days.

faqs.q: How long are the programs at Red Road Rise?
faqs.a: Red Road offers four residential lengths: Intensive at 30 days, Enhanced at 45, Comprehensive at 60 and Extensive at 90. Your counsellor and admissions help you choose based on your history and goals.

Rise is at 4891 Foothill Road SW in Salmon Arm, in BC's Shuswap region. It is about 5 hours by car from Vancouver, about 1 hour 15 minutes from Kamloops and roughly 45 minutes from Vernon. Kamloops Airport is the closest airport with regular flights.

faqs.q: Does Red Road Rise offer detox?
faqs.a: No. Red Road does not provide detox, and you must be detoxed or medically fit for treatment at intake. Your doctor or local health authority can help arrange withdrawal management first.

faqs.q: Who can go to Red Road Rise?
faqs.a: Adults aged 19 and over, men and women together, since the program is co-ed. You can refer yourself, or a First Nation Band, health authority, shelter or counsellor can refer you. People with sexual charges or offences cannot be admitted.

Yes. Red Road Recovery holds a three-year CARF accreditation, and the centre says it covers all of its programs and locations. Rise is also a registered assisted living supportive recovery residence with Interior Health.

faqs.q: What happens after I leave Red Road Rise?
faqs.a: You leave with an aftercare plan made with your counsellor. Red Road offers virtual one-to-one counselling and support meetings after treatment, and recovery.com lists online follow-up sessions and alumni reunions for Rise.

faqs.q: Is Red Road Rise the same as Red Road Recovery in Sorrento?
faqs.a: They are run by the same company and use the same program, but they are separate houses. Rise is a 10-bed home in Salmon Arm that opened in late 2024, while the original Red Road Recovery house is in Sorrento. Red Road also runs Red Road Ranch in Lumby and Red Road North in Terrace.
